name: How do you soundproof a home office addition against household noise?
description: We isolate sound by installing acoustic insulation inside the walls, hanging sound-dampening drywall, and installing solid-core doors to minimize domestic noise

mainEntity.name: How do you soundproof a home office addition against household noise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Soundproofing can be built directly into the office addition through specialized drywall installation, acoustic wall insulation, and solid-core interior doors. Standard hollow-core doors and uninsulated interior walls allow household noise to bleed into work areas. During framing and drywall installation, our team can install sound-dampening insulation batts and resilient drywall layers to block everyday domestic sounds, giving you a quiet environment for phone calls, video meetings, and focused tasks.
acceptedAnswer.description: We isolate sound by installing acoustic insulation inside the walls, hanging sound-dampening drywall, and installing solid-core doors to minimize domestic noise transfer.
